model_card.description: A pre-trained RoBERTa model fine-tuned for urgency classification in tweets related to disaster response. This model predicts whether a tweet is urgent or not based on its content.
model_card.use_case: Classifying tweets into urgent or not urgent categories for disaster response prioritization

intended_use.primary_use_case: Urgency classification for tweets in disaster response scenarios

output_format.description: Output is a label (Urgent or Not Urgent) based on the content of the tweet

limitations: The model may not perform well with tweets in languages other than English.
The model assumes that tweets are well-formed and may struggle with slang or informal language.

training_details.dataset: Canada Wildfires 2016 dataset and Hurricane Harvey 2017 dataset
